about_the_game:
Build a home. Attract pets. Grow your world.

Galactic Getaway is a cozy creature-collecting sim where your creativity brings life to your planet. Decorate, farm, and design your base to attract adorable alien pets — then earn their trust and convince them to stay. The more you build, the more they come.

🪴 Your World Starts Empty

You arrive on a quiet planet. Just soil, trees, and possibility. But every glowing crop, every strange lamp or cozy chair you place… sends a signal into the wild.

🐾 Pets Don’t Just Spawn — They Choose You

Each creature species is drawn to different decorations, crops, and environments. Some like order. Some like mess. Some only come out for a special treat.
If your world speaks their language, they’ll visit and if you bond with them through encounters, they might just stay!

🛠️ Build With Purpose

Customize your base however you like lush and wild, tidy and futuristic, chaotic and colorful. Every choice you make shapes the ecosystem, unlocks new possibilities, and changes which pets arrive next.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Play Solo or With Friends

Invite your friends to visit, decorate, and collect pets together. Trade decorations, team up to attract rare creatures, or just relax while your planets come to life.

👕 Customize Your Character

Design a cozy explorer that feels like you. Choose your hairstyle, outfit, and color palette Whether you're going full pastel space-elf or rugged galactic gardener, your vibe helps shape the world around you.

🎯 Play Fun Minigames

Take a break from decorating and dive into wholesome chaos. Compete in cozy minigames like tanks, space ball, and fashion shows. Whether you're teaming up or getting (gently) competitive, every game is a chance to bond and earn rewards.

And much more!

F.A.Q.

Does the game have controller support?

Yes! Although it's a work in progress.

Do I need internet to play this game?

Yes, at the start of every play session you need an internet connection to play.

Do I have to play multiplayer?

No, after the initial connection you can play the game singleplayer.

Is the game localized in other languages than English?

Not yet but we plan to do so hopefully by the end of the year.
